:::{#exm-skew-hermitian-matrix}
#### A skew-Hermitian matrix

The matrix

$$
\matr{A} =
\begin{bmatrix}
2\,i & 1 + i \\
-1 + i & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$

is skew-Hermitian:
transposing and conjugating gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\matr{A}^{\mathsf{H}}
&=
\begin{bmatrix}
\overline{2\,i} & \overline{-1 + i} \\
\overline{1 + i} & \overline{0}
\end{bmatrix} \\
&=
\begin{bmatrix}
-2\,i & -1 - i \\
1 - i & 0
\end{bmatrix} \\
&= -\matr{A}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Its diagonal entries $2\,i$ and $0$ are purely imaginary.
:::
